notes: Chat: Infiltrate — click someone's picture and fly your own picture around their screen with your mouse (up to 3 at once). Click to leave; 5 s without moving pops you out. They can swat you out by clicking your picture, or switch it off (“Let people infiltrate”).
Render: with “Tracks can go off the frame” on, the tracks carry on through the bottom margin instead of being cut off at it.
Tracks: while renaming, Tab jumps to the next track's name (Shift+Tab to the one before).
